metadata.notes: Evidence is core/date scope only, not all claims or artwork vetted.

reviews.title_after: A predawn EF3 tornado cuts through Hattiesburg, Mississippi
reviews.core_fact: January 21, 2017: an EF3 tornado crossed the Lamar–Forrest County/Hattiesburg area early in the morning.
reviews.source_dependence: NOAA/NCEI and NWS Jackson share original survey evidence.
reviews.unverified_cautions: Bonhomie NCEI segment belongs to the same tornado, not an extra EF3; separate early and evening outbreak rounds and county injury counts.
reviews.graphic_concept: Original EF-rated Hattiesburg track and overnight timing map

reviews.title_after: The Askewville–Colerain EF3 devastates eastern North Carolina
reviews.core_fact: An EF3 tornado struck Askewville, North Carolina, on April 16, 2011.
reviews.source_dependence: Same NOAA storm survey in NCEI and NWS Wakefield reports.
reviews.unverified_cautions: Wakefield documented a separate parallel EF2 track at Colerain; do not combine them, count county segments as storms, or mistake provisional survey details for final.

reviews.title_after: An F3 tornado tears through Ogden during Illinois's 1996 outbreak
reviews.core_fact: An F3 tornado hit Ogden, Illinois, on April 19, 1996.
reviews.source_dependence: NCEI and NWS Lincoln draw from same historical Storm Data survey.
reviews.unverified_cautions: Historical Fujita F3 NOT EF3; Ogden is one track of a larger April 19 tornado outbreak, with historical statewide counts potentially differing by revision.
reviews.graphic_concept: Original Ogden tornado track within separate statewide paths

reviews.title_after: A long-track tornado starts near Jamestown before devastating southeast Kentucky
reviews.core_fact: A long-track tornado began near Jamestown, Kentucky, on May 16, 2025 and intensified as it traversed southeast Kentucky into May 17.
reviews.source_dependence: Multiple NWS office analyses and NCEI share tornado survey provenance.
reviews.unverified_cautions: Goodwater/Jamestown NCEI record is a partial segment; strongest EF4 damage farther along the track, and midnight local date crossover needs explicit time checks.
reviews.graphic_concept: Original damage-rating-by-time map crossing local midnight

reviews.title_after: North Dakota's Enderlin EF5 tornado precedes a powerful derecho
reviews.location_after: Enderlin and Ransom/Cass Counties, North Dakota
reviews.core_fact: The June 20, 2025 Enderlin tornado reached a final surveyed EF5 rating, during an outbreak also featuring a damaging derecho.
reviews.source_dependence: Initial and later NOAA tornado analyses originate in the same storm survey; rating is damage-inferred.
reviews.unverified_cautions: The NCEI Elizabeth segment may still mention EF4, superseded by October 2025 final NWS EF5 for the single Enderlin #1 tornado. Do not extend EF5 over all track or mix derecho damage.
reviews.graphic_concept: Original Enderlin tornado EF shading and separate derecho wind swath

reviews.title_after: Hurricane Audrey makes a devastating southwest Louisiana landfall
reviews.location_after: Cameron Parish, Louisiana and upper Texas coast
reviews.core_fact: Hurricane Audrey made landfall along the Texas–Louisiana coast in Cameron Parish on June 27, 1957.
reviews.source_dependence: NWS Lake Charles history and LSU archival finding guide confirm date; LSU is not an independent wind sensor.
reviews.unverified_cautions: Published retrospective landfall time and Category 3 vs 4 intensity interpretations vary; omit exact peak winds, fatalities, tide or category unless separately reconciled.
reviews.graphic_concept: Original 1957 hurricane track, coastal surge and warning-timing graphic

reviews.title_after: Lightning ignites California's LNU Lightning Complex
reviews.core_fact: August 17, 2020 lightning ignitions evolved into Northern California's LNU Lightning Complex.
reviews.source_dependence: State CAL FIRE incident provenance is separate from NCEI weather-report publisher, while ignition observations are shared.
reviews.unverified_cautions: CAL FIRE final incident acreage 363,220 is a multiweek total, NOT the area burned August 17; distinguish initial lightning strikes from merged complex perimeter.
reviews.graphic_concept: Original lightning-footprint and individual fire ignition map

reviews.title_before: Wildfire — SAN BERNARDINO AND RIVERSIDE COUNTY VALLEYS - THE INLAND EMPIRE, California
reviews.title_after: The Fairview Fire begins near Hemet, California
reviews.core_fact: The Fairview Fire began near Hemet, California, on September 5, 2022.
reviews.source_dependence: CAL FIRE original incident metadata and NCEI county weather report separately document same incident.
reviews.unverified_cautions: Start-day perimeter is not eventual total acreage or damage; ignition time and cause require exact official investigation source, not derived inference.
reviews.graphic_concept: Original ignition and Sep 5 wind/terrain context map

reviews.title_after: Helene makes Florida Big Bend landfall before damaging south Georgia
reviews.location_after: Florida Big Bend and Lowndes County, Georgia
reviews.core_fact: Hurricane Helene made Florida Big Bend landfall late September 26, 2024 before rapidly tracking into Georgia.
reviews.source_dependence: NOAA NCEI and NWS Tallahassee use common storm reporting but different scopes.
reviews.unverified_cautions: Lowndes GA wind/impact record is a separate place and period; several Georgia impacts continued after midnight Sep 27. Do not date every impact Sep 26.
reviews.graphic_concept: Original storm-center and local impact timestamps across Sep26–27

reviews.title_before: Tornado — FT PIERCE NELSON ARP, Florida
reviews.title_after: Milton's rainbands spawn an EF3 tornado near Fort Pierce
reviews.core_fact: A long-track EF3 tornado associated with Hurricane Milton struck the Fort Pierce–Vero Beach region on October 9, 2024.
reviews.source_dependence: NCEI location segments and NWS Melbourne survey share track and damage inputs.
reviews.unverified_cautions: Separate rainband tornado from later hurricane center landfall on Florida west coast; EF3/155 mph damage estimate is not instrument-measured sustained wind.
reviews.graphic_concept: Original hurricane rainband and separate EF3 tornado track

reviews.title_after: Wind-excited aeroelastic flutter collapses the Tacoma Narrows Bridge
reviews.core_fact: The original Tacoma Narrows Bridge collapsed November 7, 1940 during high-amplitude wind-excited torsional motion.
reviews.source_dependence: Washington State DOT engineering history and ASCE account independently discuss the failure, based on shared engineering archives.
reviews.unverified_cautions: The ~42-mph observation was at one part of bridge, not a uniform threshold. Aeroelastic flutter, not simple static wind push, was cause; film/photo licensing unreviewed.
reviews.graphic_concept: Original two-stage torsional flutter explanatory cross-section with wind timeline

reviews.title_after: An F4 tornado tears through Huntsville during evening rush hour
reviews.secondary_publisher: UNT Libraries digitized federal Storm Data
reviews.core_fact: A violent F4 tornado struck Huntsville, Alabama, on November 15, 1989 during evening rush hour.
reviews.source_dependence: NWS Huntsville retrospective and digitized contemporary federal Storm Data share the underlying original survey.
reviews.unverified_cautions: F4 on the original Fujita scale, not EF4. Avoid summing casualty totals across track segments and reconcile differing contemporary property-loss estimates.
reviews.graphic_concept: Original 1989 F4 tornado track and issue/impact warning chronology

reviews.title_after: Lake-effect snow bands ease after an extended northern Indiana event
reviews.location_after: South Bend and southeast of Lake Michigan, Indiana
reviews.core_fact: A prolonged November 15–20, 2022 lake-effect event brought snow bands and squalls to northern Indiana.
reviews.source_dependence: Curated lead and NWS analysis use same agency observations, not independent snow measurement.
reviews.unverified_cautions: NWS South Bend's 30.2 inches is cumulative from November 1–20, not just Nov20; some snow squalls occurred Nov19. Do not assign entire episode to one anniversary.
reviews.graphic_concept: Original Lake Michigan band position/snow totals chronology

reviews.title_after: A damaging tornado crosses St. Tammany Parish into Mississippi
reviews.location_after: Covington, Louisiana to Pearl River County, Mississippi
reviews.core_fact: A tornado tracked from St. Tammany Parish, Louisiana into Pearl River County, Mississippi on November 21, 1997.
reviews.source_dependence: NWS local historical summary and NCEI county entries use overlapping original reports.
reviews.unverified_cautions: NCEI LA segment F2 vs MS segment F1; do not call the full path F2 or sum fatality/injury counts across county reports. Historic F ratings NOT EF.
reviews.graphic_concept: Original separate state-segment tornado track with historic F ratings

reviews.title_after: Christmas Day rain triggers deadly debris flows on California burn scars
reviews.location_after: Devore and Waterman Canyon, San Bernardino County, California
reviews.core_fact: Christmas Day 2003 rain over fresh San Bernardino Mountains fire scars triggered destructive debris flows, including near Devore.
reviews.source_dependence: County flood-control original chronology and USGS image site independently locate postfire debris flow, complement NCEI local record.
reviews.unverified_cautions: Devore campground and Waterman Canyon church camp are separate loss sites; not all regional deaths were in Devore. A USGS page says photo public domain, but actual selected final asset/crop/credit remains unreviewed.
reviews.graphic_concept: Original burn scar rain and drainage/impacts overlay
